entries.title: Opening the notebook
entries.body:
This is the beginning of After Hours: a place to collect rides, projects, interests, and days worth remembering.

The idea is simple. Keep a few photographs. Write down what mattered. Let the small things have a place alongside the bigger ones.

The garage will follow the MT-03 as it changes. The journal has room for everything else.

entries.title: The MT-03, so far
entries.body:
The starting point is a 2021 Yamaha MT-03. Its setup includes an Akrapovič full exhaust, Rapid Bike EVO, 14/46 gearing, a TST quick throttle, a Saddlemen seat, and Shogun sliders.

This is the first page of the build record. Future notes can hold the reasons behind a change, the work involved, and the impressions that come afterward.

The current setup lives in the garage, with the story of each change collected here.
